text:
emily: Heads-up: scheduling v2 traffic slope rollout Tuesday 02:00 UTC. Goal: 1% -> 30% over 90m. Need ops + runtime eyes. Will trigger via deploy-bot in 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout plan created by emily. Parameters: version=v2, strategy=slope, start=1%, end=30%, duration=90m, canary=2 tenants. Prechecks pending.

raj: Recommend we add tenant pin override for old SDKs. If header `X-API-Client: legacy` then route to v1.

marco: Agree. Add telemetry gates: error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 2x -> auto-pause + notify ops.

ops_lead: Operator handoff at 01:50 UTC. I'll watch NA/EU regions for the first 20m and keep pager open. If we see regional 5xx spike, we pin affected tenants immediately.

carla: I'll draft release notes: "v2: schema negotiation fixes, streaming reliability improvements. Breaking change: header name canonicalization (clients should send X-API-Version). Recommend SDK >= 1.4." Will post to #release-notes once final.

deploy-bot: Rollout command (example):
```
/deploybot start --version=v2 --strategy=slope --start=1 --end=30 --duration=90m --canary=2
```
Prechecks: healthchecks=true, metrics-sinks=enabled, rollback-policy=auto-pause+notify.

emily: Add fallback behavior: unknown client versions -> treat as legacy and route to v1 (safety-first). Also set header `X-Rollback-Allowed: false` for pinned tenants.

raj: Adding KPI watchlist: 5xx-rate, latency_p95, error_count_by_tenant, token_cost_per_minute. Keep 1m and 5m windows.

marco: :thumbsup: I'll update the ops runbook with the tenant pin list and pin/unpin playbook.

ops_lead: I'll be on-call 02:00-04:00 UTC. Escalation: if anomaly persists after 10m -> page eng-runtime.

emily: Manual rollback criteria (if auto pause doesn't resolve): >1% 5xx for 5m OR >30% increase in p95 across both NA & EU for 10m -> full rollback to v1.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: starting rollout in 10 minutes unless paused. Queue status: READY. To cancel: `/deploybot cancel --thread=3390123456`.

carla: :eyes: posting release note snapshot to #marketing and #customers at -5m. Will include SDK upgrade instructions and opt-out header.

raj: Tenant pin API sample (ops):
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/tenants/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"acme","version":"v1","reason":"post-rollout spike"}'
```

marco: Gateway note: enable `canonicalize-api-version` to true to avoid header-case issues from older clients. Also add quick metric: pinned_tenants_count.

emily: Anything else? If no objections, we'll kick at 02:00 UTC and report progress in this thread.

ops_lead: No objections. :rocket: I'll hand off to on-call at 01:50 and monitor dashboards.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Will post step updates: CANARY -> SLOPE -> RAMP -> STABLE. Status updates will appear here.
